title: Detecting and Repairing Hallucinations in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
abstract: arXiv:2608.29307v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Language models increasingly answer questions by consulting retrieved documents rather than memory alone, a design now common in search assistants and enterprise knowledge tools. Grounding a model in retrieved text reduces unsupported statements but does not eliminate them, and a reader cannot tell a grounded sentence from an invented one. Most research on this problem stops at detection, yet flagging a faulty answer changes nothing for the person reading it, and little is known about which action should follow. Using RAGTruth, a benchmark whose unsupported passages are annotated by hand, we split each flagged answer into individual factual claims, check each against the retrieved source, and compare leaving the answer untouched with three repair strategies of increasing richness: deleting an unsupported claim, replacing it with source text, and rewriting it. Three language models from different families judge the 916 repaired answers.

translated_title: 检测与修复检索增强生成中的幻觉
translated_abstract: 语言模型越来越多地通过查阅检索到的文档而非仅凭记忆来回答问题，这一设计如今在搜索助手和企业知识工具中已十分常见。将模型建立在检索文本之上可以减少无依据的陈述，但并不能完全消除它们，而且读者无法区分哪句话是有依据的、哪句话是编造的。针对这一问题的大多数研究都止步于检测，然而仅仅标记出一个有误的答案对阅读者来说毫无改变，而且对于检测之后应该采取什么行动，人们知之甚少。我们使用RAGTruth——一个由人工标注无依据段落的基准——将每个被标记的答案拆分为单个事实性陈述，逐条对照检索到的源文本进行检查，并将“保持答案不变”与三种丰富程度递增的修复策略进行比较：删除无依据的陈述、用源文本替换它、以及重写它。来自不同系列的三个语言模型对这916个修复后的答案进行了评判。
tldr: 该论文超越了对检索增强生成中幻觉的单纯检测，提出将答案拆分为事实性陈述并对照检索源文本，采用删除、替换、重写三种递进策略进行自动修复，并由三个不同系列的语言模型对916个修复答案进行评估。
en_tdlr: This paper moves beyond hallucination detection in retrieval-augmented generation by splitting flagged answers into individual factual claims and applying three progressive repair strategies—deletion, replacement with source text, and rewriting—evaluated by three language models from different families on 916 repaired answers.
